events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: English actor, comedian, screenwriter, and producer John Cleese, best known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: Comedy Legend
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the legendary John Cleese! From Python to Fawlty Towers, his comedic genius is timeless.

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' released in 1968
events.blurb: The Beatles' ninth studio album, officially titled 'The Beatles' but commonly known as the 'White Album', was released on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: Iconic Album
angles.copy: 58 years since The Beatles unleashed the iconic 'White Album' upon the world. A groundbreaking double LP that still sounds incredible.

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury, would have been 80
events.blurb: Today marks 35 years since the passing of Queen frontman Freddie Mercury, who would have been 80 years old this year.

angles.name: Legendary Voice
angles.copy: Remembering the one and only Freddie Mercury, whose incredible voice and stage presence remain unmatched. He would have been 80 today.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' released in 1965
events.blurb: The Beatles released their sixth studio album, 'Rubber Soul', in the United Kingdom on December 3, 1965.

angles.name: Revolutionary Sound
angles.copy: On this day in 1965, The Beatles dropped 'Rubber Soul'. An album that pushed boundaries and set new standards for pop music.

events.title: Remembering John Lennon, would have been 86
events.blurb: Today marks 46 years since the tragic death of The Beatles co-founder John Lennon, who would have been 86 years old.

angles.name: Peace & Music
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon, a visionary whose music and message of peace continue to resonate. He would have been 86 today.

events.title: Remembering David Bowie, would have been 80
events.blurb: Today would have been the 80th birthday of the iconic musician, actor, and artist David Bowie.

angles.name: Starman's Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering the legend David Bowie on what would have been his 80th birthday. His artistry truly changed the world.

events.title: Remembering Elvis Presley, would have been 92
events.blurb: Today would have been the 92nd birthday of the 'King of Rock and Roll', Elvis Presley.

angles.name: The King Lives On
angles.copy: Celebrating the enduring legacy of Elvis Presley, who would have turned 92 today. The King's influence is still felt far and wide.

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83
events.blurb: English guitarist, songwriter, and record producer Jimmy Page, best known as the founder of Led Zeppelin, celebrates his 83rd birthday.

angles.name: Guitar God
angles.copy: Happy 83rd birthday to the legendary Jimmy Page! The Led Zeppelin maestro continues to inspire generations of guitarists.

events.title: Rod Stewart turns 82
events.blurb: British singer-songwriter Sir Rod Stewart, known for his distinctive raspy singing voice, celebrates his 82nd birthday.

angles.name: Rock & Roll Icon
angles.copy: Raise a glass! The one and only Rod Stewart is 82 today. Still rocking after all these years!

events.title: Suggs turns 66
events.blurb: Graham McPherson, better known as Suggs, the lead singer of the iconic British ska band Madness, celebrates his 66th birthday.

angles.name: Madness Frontman
angles.copy: Happy 66th birthday to Suggs, the inimitable frontman of Madness! Still stepping out in style.

events.title: Paul Young turns 71
events.blurb: British singer-songwriter Paul Young, famous for his 80s hits like 'Wherever I Lay My Hat (That's My Home)', celebrates his 71st birthday.

angles.name: 80s Pop Icon
angles.copy: Happy 71st birthday to the smooth voice of Paul Young! Still got that soulful touch.

events.title: Remembering Dolly Parton, would have been 81
events.blurb: Today would have been the 81st birthday of the legendary American country music singer, songwriter, and actress Dolly Parton.

angles.name: Queen of Country
angles.copy: Remembering the one and only Dolly Parton on what would have been her 81st birthday. A true icon and trailblazer.

events.title: Gary Barlow turns 56
events.blurb: English singer, songwriter, and record producer Gary Barlow, best known as the frontman of Take That, celebrates his 56th birthday.

angles.name: Take That Leader
angles.copy: Happy 56th birthday to Take That's very own Gary Barlow! A fantastic songwriter and performer.

events.title: Billy Ocean turns 77
events.blurb: Trinidadian-British singer-songwriter Billy Ocean, known for his string of R&B and pop hits in the 70s and 80s, celebrates his 77th birthday.

angles.name: Soulful Voice
angles.copy: Happy 77th birthday to the incredible Billy Ocean! His timeless hits still get us dancing.

events.title: First Rock and Roll Hall Of Fame induction ceremony (1989)
events.blurb: On January 24, 1989, the first induction ceremony for the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame was held in New York City.

angles.name: Music History
angles.copy: Remembering the inaugural Rock and Roll Hall Of Fame induction in 1989. Who were your favourite first-ever inductees?

events.title: Mark Owen turns 55
events.blurb: English singer-songwriter Mark Owen, best known as a member of Take That, celebrates his 55th birthday.

angles.name: Take That Star
angles.copy: Happy 55th birthday to Take That's Mark Owen! Still charming the nation after all these years.
